summary.vi: 11 giai đoạn, quote/order/failure traces và ba lab về cart merge, inventory expiry/late auth, shuffle isolation; giải thích rõ authority và recovery xuyên boundaries.

title.vi: 1. Mỗi domain cần consistency khác nhau
title.en: 1. Each domain needs its own consistency

paragraphs.vi: Một store không có một consistency knob chung. Browse catalog có thể hơi cũ; cart có thể giữ concurrent edits; inventory quyết ai sở hữu hàng; payment biết external money state; order giữ contract và tiến độ. Bài này xây checkout kiểu Amazon theo 11 pressures/giai đoạn, không mô tả inventory hiện tại của một công ty.
paragraphs.en: A store has no single consistency knob. Catalogs tolerate bounded staleness; carts merge edits; inventory allocates goods; payments own external money evidence; orders retain contracts and progress. This lesson builds an Amazon-style checkout through eleven pressures, not a current company deployment inventory.

paragraphs.vi: Chọn hard-stock, no-backorder cho lab; nếu product cho oversell/backorder thì invariant và UX phải đổi có chủ đích. Cart item không là stock hold, queue token không là order confirmation, authorization không là captured/settled money. Những phân biệt này quan trọng hơn tên database.
paragraphs.en: Labs assume hard stock without backorders. Allowing backorders changes invariants and UX deliberately. Cart items are not stock holds, queue tokens are not order confirmations, and authorization is not capture/settlement. These distinctions matter more than database names.

items.vi: Stale display và conflicting intent có policy; không tự charge từ cached price.
items.en: Bound stale displays and conflicting intent; never charge directly from cached prices.

items.vi: Quantities, owners, state versions và accepted results cần recover được.
items.en: Recover quantities, ownership, state versions and accepted results.

items.vi: External outcomes có ambiguity và irreversible effects; theo dõi identities riêng.
items.en: External outcomes can be uncertain or irreversible; track separate identities.

title.vi: 2. Chốt semantics của nút Place order

paragraphs.vi: Request gồm immutable cart/quote version, delivery choice và stable checkout identity. Backend xác nhận price/discount/tax/shipping/currency tại authority; nếu thay đổi vật chất, trả requote/consent thay silently charge amount khác. Retained request hash ngăn cùng identity bị tái dùng cho cart khác.
paragraphs.en: Requests carry immutable cart/quote versions, delivery choices and stable checkout identities. Revalidate totals/currency at authority and obtain consent for material changes instead of silently charging another amount. Retained request hashes reject identity reuse with changed carts.

paragraphs.vi: Phân biệt ORDER_RECEIVED, PENDING_PAYMENT, CONFIRMED, ALLOCATED, PARTIALLY_SHIPPED, SHIPPED, CANCEL_PENDING và terminal states. Product có thể gọi received là “placed” nhưng phải nói rõ cho người dùng. Confirmation trong thiết kế này cần durable order state, hợp lệ inventory allocation và acceptable payment evidence; shipment/capture về sau có sub-state riêng.
paragraphs.en: Distinguish received, payment pending, confirmed, allocated, partially shipped, shipped, cancellation pending and terminal states. Product labels must explain their guarantees. Confirmation here needs durable state, valid allocation and acceptable payment evidence; shipping/capture retain separate substates.

paragraphs.vi: Mỗi stage có áp lực, lựa chọn, trade-off, điều kiện đi tiếp và exit criteria. Modular monolith phù hợp khi transaction locality và team size còn tốt; distributed workflow chỉ đáng chi phí khi boundaries thực sự tồn tại. Không xem số services hoặc server là thước đo trưởng thành.
paragraphs.en: Each stage states pressure, decisions, trade-offs, next triggers and exit criteria. Modular monoliths fit local transactions and small teams; distributed workflows justify their cost only when boundaries actually exist. Service/server counts do not measure maturity.

description.vi: Modular app và relational DB giữ cart/order/inventory cùng một transaction domain khi team còn nhỏ. External payment vẫn ngoài transaction: payment record local không có nghĩa bank đã authorize/capture. Bắt đầu với idempotent order creation, stock invariants và pending UI.
description.en: A modular app and relational database keep carts, orders and inventory local for a small team. External payment remains outside the transaction: local payment rows do not establish bank effects. Start with stable order identities, inventory invariants and pending UI.

title.en: 4. Peak checkout differs from hot-key contention

paragraphs.vi: Ví dụ synthetic: 600K checkout requests trong15 phút; browse80pages/checkout; một deal có5000units và240Kattempts trong30giây. Không dùng các số này làm Amazon metrics. Retry, multi-item/multi-warehouse, fulfillment events và duplicates làm operations lớn hơn customer orders.
paragraphs.en: Assume synthetic traffic of600K checkout requests in fifteen minutes, eighty browse pages per checkout, and a five-thousand-unit deal with240K attempts in thirty seconds. These are not Amazon metrics. Retries, multi-item/warehouse work and events exceed customer order counts.

paragraphs.vi: Scale total storage khác serialize một contested quantity. Có thể chia stock thành disjoint escrow buckets nếu sum budgets giữ đúng và transfers/rebalancing atomic; không clone “available=5000” vào mọi bucket. Admission giảm wasted attempts nhưng inventory authority vẫn quyết winners.
paragraphs.en: Total storage scaling differs from serializing contested quantities. Disjoint escrow buckets can spread work if total budgets and transfers remain correct; cloning full stock into each bucket oversells. Admission reduces wasted attempts while inventory still decides winners.

title.vi: 7. Cart conflicts: additions, removals và quantities
title.en: 7. Cart conflicts: additions, removals and quantities

paragraphs.vi: Cart nên giữ user intent qua offline edits nếu đó là product contract. Một membership merge có thể là observed-remove set: mỗi add có tag riêng, remove ghi tags đã quan sát. Concurrent fresh add có thể giữ item theo add-wins; user đã remove-all trên mọi devices là semantics mạnh hơn và cần design khác. Union không biết deletion; whole-document LWW làm independent edit biến mất khi wall clocks lệch.
paragraphs.en: Preserve offline intent under a chosen product contract. Observed-remove membership assigns add tags and records observed removals. Fresh concurrent additions may survive under add-wins; remove-all requires stronger semantics. Union forgets deletions, and document LWW loses independent edits under skew.

paragraphs.vi: Lab chỉ membership, không giải quantity. Quantity có set-to-X, increment/decrement hoặc per-device contributions với business caps; chọn semantics trước CRDT. Tombstone/tag GC cần causal stability, bounded offline horizon hoặc forced epoch resync. Cart accepted ACK chỉ hứa mức durability của selected replicas, không “always succeeds” dưới mọi failure. Checkout luôn revalidate strict authorities.
paragraphs.en: The lab covers membership, not quantity. Quantities may use assignments, deltas or device contributions with caps; choose semantics before data structures. Garbage collection needs causal stability, bounded offline history or forced epoch resync. Acknowledgements depend on reachable durable capacity, and checkout revalidates authorities.

title.vi: 8. Inventory hold là một state machine atomic
title.en: 8. Inventory holds are atomic state machines

paragraphs.vi: Conservation cho hard stock: available + active held + committed allocated = allocatable total, cộng các explicit adjustment/return states nếu có. Atomic decrement và INSERT hold/result phải commit cùng boundary; nếu decrement thành công rồi INSERT crash thì hàng mất ownership. Release/expire chỉ đổi ACTIVE→RELEASED/EXPIRED một lần và increment trong cùng commit.
paragraphs.en: For hard stock, available plus active holds plus committed allocation equals total, extended by explicit adjustments/returns. Commit decrements, hold records and results together; otherwise crashes lose ownership. Terminal release/expiry increments stock atomically and only once.

paragraphs.vi: Commit hold cần current owner/order/generation, expected state và server expiry policy tại serialization point. TTL sweeper có thể trễ; read/commit checks vẫn phải reject expired ownership. TTL dài hơn payment p99 chỉ giảm frequency, không chứng minh race hết xảy ra. Late authorization sau release cần void/reconcile, còn capture rồi mới phát hiện không có hàng cần refund/fulfillment exception.
paragraphs.en: Commit under current order ownership, generation, state and server expiry at the serialization point. Sweepers may lag; expired holds still cannot commit. Long TTLs reduce frequency without eliminating races. Late authorizations need void/reconciliation; captured money without stock needs refund/exception handling.

title.vi: 9. Workflow durability không xóa external crash window
title.en: 9. Workflow durability does not erase external crash windows

paragraphs.vi: Mỗi step có durable intent/command ID, participant result, retry policy và next state. Nếu authorize thành công nhưng workflow chưa ghi result thì replay phải query/retry same payment operation; “resume last completed step” không đủ nếu completed chưa recorded. Participant phải enforce identity cùng effect hoặc expose reliable recovery protocol. Event delivery at-least-once cần idempotent sinks, không chỉ consumer offset.
paragraphs.en: Each step retains intent, command identity, participant results, retry policy and next state. If authorization succeeds before recording its result, replay queries/retries the same operation. Resuming the last recorded step alone is insufficient; participants must enforce identity or expose recovery.

paragraphs.vi: Saga không có isolation tự động: hai workflows cùng stock/cart/order cần authority checks/semantic locks để không contradictory transitions. Compensation có thể fail, không reverse emails/physical shipment hoặc guaranteed instant refund. Giữ COMPENSATION_PENDING, backoff/reconciliation và manual resolution path. 2PC có thể dùng khi participants thật sự support protocol, nhưng external providers thường không cùng transaction domain; NoSQL cũng có thể hỗ trợ transactions trong scope cụ thể.
paragraphs.en: Sagas do not automatically isolate concurrent workflows. Authorities or semantic locks must guard contradictory transitions. Compensation can fail and cannot reverse notifications or dispatched goods. Retain pending repair/manual resolution. Cooperating participants may use2PC; external providers usually do not share that domain, and NoSQL products may support scoped transactions.

persist AUTH_REQUESTED(order, operation_id, payload_hash)
dispatch authorize using the SAME operation_id

# Crash here may leave a successful provider effect with no local result.
on timeout or restart:
  retain PENDING_PAYMENT
  query/retry operation_id under the provider's documented contract
  never replace ambiguity with a fabricated DECLINED result

  validate exact current hold, owner, generation and expiry at inventory authority
  if allocation can still commit: persist confirmation + fulfillment intent
  else: persist void/reconciliation intent; do not reclaim resold stock
on definitive decline:
  run the guarded release transition and record cancellation progress
# Compensation itself can fail and must retain its own operation identity.

title.vi: 10. Authorization, partial shipment và money reconciliation

paragraphs.vi: Authorize-at-order/capture-at-dispatch là selected method policy, không universal legal rule. Authorization có expiry/amount/partial-capture constraints; payment method có thể immediate charge hoặc asynchronous approval. Shipping pipeline cần commit policy khi capture fails/unknown, reauthorization consent nếu cần và unique external capture per shipment.
paragraphs.en: Order-time authorization and dispatch-time capture are selected policy, not universal law. Methods have expiry, amount and capture rules or asynchronous approval. Dispatch must define behavior for failed/unknown capture, reauthorization consent and unique shipment capture identities.

paragraphs.vi: Order-level total cap không thay per-shipment idempotency; idempotency không ngăn cumulative overcapture nếu distinct operation IDs đều valid. Refund/void là different actions theo settled state; webhook stale status không overwrite terminal result. Reconcile order→provider→settlement/ledger bằng references, amounts và currency. Balanced accounting chưa chứng minh đầy đủ mọi legitimate order event.
paragraphs.en: Order caps and shipment idempotency solve different problems. Distinct valid operation IDs can still overcapture without aggregate limits. Void/refund depend on state, and stale events cannot overwrite results. Reconcile order, provider and settlement evidence by identity, amount and currency.

title.vi: 11. Cells khác shuffle sharding, overlap khác outage
title.en: 11. Cells differ from shuffle sharding; overlap differs from outage

paragraphs.vi: Cell là independently bounded slice của serving/data/ownership; router nhỏ có stable placement/epoch và không randomly reroute writes sang owner khác. Shared control/auth/catalog/payment dependencies cần failure budgets/fallbacks riêng; shared database toàn fleet làm cell isolation giảm. Deployment cell-by-cell với health gates giảm correlated bad rollout.
paragraphs.en: Cells bound serving, data and ownership. Stable routers must not randomly redirect writes across owners. Shared authentication, catalog or payment dependencies need independent controls; shared databases weaken isolation. Gated cell-by-cell deployment limits correlated rollout failures.

paragraphs.vi: Shuffle subset chọn một số workers cho tenant/job để ít shared fate hơn plain partition. Với8workers, subsets2workers có28combinations; fault ở2workers làm1subset không có healthy target. Nhưng partial overlap vẫn gây first-attempt failure; retry phải distinct, idempotent, bounded bởi deadline/capacity. Không biến1/28 exact-overlap thành generic availability SLO.
paragraphs.en: Shuffle subsets reduce shared fate. Two-worker subsets from eight workers yield twenty-eight combinations; two failed workers fully disable one subset. Partial overlaps still fail initial attempts. Distinct bounded idempotent retries depend on deadlines/capacity, so exact-overlap probability is not a generic availability SLO.

headers.en: Two failed workers out of eight

rows.vi: Retry healthy target có thể hoàn tất
rows.en: Retrying the healthy target can complete
Worker retries do not repair the dependency

caption.vi: Uniform tenant subsets, equal request weights, random order không lặp target và đủ deadline/capacity cho retry. Đây là phân tích một fault đã cho, không phải availability SLO hoặc bằng chứng retries miễn phí.
caption.en: Assume uniform subsets, equal traffic weights, random distinct targets and enough deadline/capacity for retries. This analyzes one given fault; it is not an availability SLO or a claim that retries are free.

title.vi: 12. Peak day: goodput, fairness và bounded waiting
title.en: 12. Peak days: goodput, fairness and bounded waiting

paragraphs.vi: Pre-scale capacity/database connections, warm cache and test target workload including degraded dependencies. Concurrency limits theo useful downstream work tốt hơn chỉ LB open connections. Queue có max length/wait, cancellation, signed principal-bound tokens và explicit queue-position semantics; token không bypass stock authority. Dedupe refresh/retry, chống bot/captcha/rate abuse theo product fairness.
paragraphs.en: Pre-scale capacity/connections, warm caches and test degraded dependencies. Limit useful downstream concurrency rather than only open connections. Bound queues and waiting, cancellation and scoped tokens; queued admission never bypasses inventory. Deduplicate retries and apply abuse/fairness policy.

paragraphs.vi: Shed optional reviews/recommendations trước strict order/payment, nhưng security/fraud/compliance checks không bị bỏ chỉ vì “không kiếm tiền ngay”. Timeout/retry budgets end-to-end ngăn upstream retry storm. Escrow stock buckets cần disjoint budgets, ownership và safe rebalance; capacity gate hiển thị approximate remaining khác authoritative units available. Measure successful confirmed orders, tail/wait/drop và fairness cohorts.
paragraphs.en: Degrade optional discovery before critical ordering, while retaining required security checks. End-to-end budgets prevent retry storms. Escrow buckets need disjoint budgets and safe rebalancing; approximate displayed counts do not authorize units. Measure useful orders, tails, waiting, drops and fairness.

title.vi: 13. Delivery promise, recommendation và lifecycle after checkout

paragraphs.vi: Promise combines warehouse stock, pick/pack queues, transport calendars/cutoffs, service class và address region. Cache key phải gồm dimensions ảnh hưởng output và time-bucket validity; invalidation khi capacity/stock changes. Checkout revalidates và retains accepted promise version. Multi-package order có từng ETA/amount, chưa thể dùng fastest warehouse date cho cả giỏ hàng.
paragraphs.en: Promises combine warehouse stock, processing queues, calendars, cutoffs, service class and regions. Cache keys need relevant dimensions and validity; stock/capacity changes invalidate them. Checkout retains accepted versions. Multiple packages have separate dates/amounts rather than one fastest-warehouse estimate.

paragraphs.vi: Fulfillment giữ allocation/shipment IDs, scan/dispatch evidence, retries và exception routing. Inventory physical damage/returns/restocking tạo explicit adjustments, không chỉ update available từ cached order count. Cancel sau dispatch có return/refund workflow khác cancel trước allocation. Audit/history giúp customer support giải thích order partial/pending thay một boolean “paid”.
paragraphs.en: Fulfillment retains allocation/shipment identities, dispatch evidence and exception handling. Damage and returns create explicit adjustments rather than cached-count updates. Post-dispatch cancellation needs return/refund workflows. Retained history explains partial/pending orders better than one paid boolean.

paragraphs.vi: Recommendations có offline build + bounded online seeds/merge; item-item similarity không đồng nghĩa every pair có materialized row. Filter prohibited/unavailable/current audience, version data/model và provide cold-start fallback. Recommendations có thể eventual nhưng không là source cho price, tax, inventory hay delivery commitment.
paragraphs.en: Recommendations combine offline builds with bounded online seed merging; item similarity does not require unrestricted pair materialization. Filter eligibility and version data/models with cold-start fallback. Recommendations never authorize prices, inventory or delivery commitments.

title.vi: 14. Failure matrix: customer outcome và recovery evidence
title.en: 14. Failure matrix: outcomes and recovery evidence

paragraphs.vi: Nối checkout/order/hold/payment/shipment IDs trong traces; không log card secrets hoặc toàn address tùy tiện. Dashboard cho unknown money, expired holds, stuck workflows, duplicate releases, compensation age và queue fairness. Tách customer order conversion khỏi infrastructure request success.
paragraphs.en: Correlate checkout, order, hold, payment and shipment identities without logging secrets or unnecessary addresses. Monitor unknown money, expired holds, stuck workflows, repeated releases, compensation age and queue fairness. Infrastructure success does not establish customer conversion.

title.vi: 15. Worked interview: kiểm assumptions trước tối ưu
title.en: 15. Worked interview: test assumptions before optimization

paragraphs.vi: Giải thích một cart→quote→hold→authorize→confirm trước, rồi chọn hot key, workflow hoặc isolation làm deep dive. Với mỗi lựa chọn, nêu authority, lost reply, pending state và retry identity. Các đáp án dưới không bắt mọi store phải dùng eventual carts hay saga.
paragraphs.en: Trace carts, quotes, holds, authorization and confirmation before choosing hot keys, workflows or isolation for a deep dive. Explain authority, lost replies, pending states and retry identities without prescribing eventual carts or sagas universally.

question.vi: Atomic decrement riêng có đủ cho reservation?
question.en: Is a standalone atomic decrement enough for reservations?

answer.vi: Không. Stock giảm phải đi cùng hold owner/quantity/expiry/generation, unique result và intent trong transaction/equivalent protocol. Nếu INSERThold crash sau decrement thì conservation counters có thể đẹp nhưng ownership mất.
answer.en: No. Retain ownership, quantities, expiry, generations, results and intent with the stock transition. A crash after decrement can lose ownership even when counters appear plausible.

question.vi: Hold hết hạn rồi payment authorize thành công thì sao?
question.en: What if authorization succeeds after hold expiry?

answer.vi: Recheck current hold/state/expiry/generation tại authority. Không commit stock đã release hoặc bán lại. Retain pending void/reconciliation; captured money cần refund/exception policy khác. Timeout không chứng minh decline.
answer.en: Revalidate current ownership/state, expiry and generation. Do not commit released/resold units. Retain void/reconciliation; captured money needs a different refund/exception policy. Timeouts do not establish declines.

question.vi: Mọi saga step có undo là đủ ACID không?
question.en: Does an undo action for every saga step provide ACID?

answer.vi: Không. Saga không tự isolation, undo có thể fail hoặc không reverse physical effect. Guard concurrent transitions, retain compensation progress và manual repair; participant idempotency xử lý effect/result crash gap.
answer.en: No. Sagas do not automatically isolate, and undo may fail or not reverse physical effects. Guard concurrency, retain repair progress and preserve participant identities across crash gaps.

question.vi: Tại sao cart item quay lại chưa chắc là bug?
question.en: Why is a returning cart item not always a bug?

answer.vi: Observed-remove/add-wins có thể giữ fresh concurrent add b2 dù b1 bị remove. Old tag b1 quay lại sau lost tombstone là issue khác. Contract remove-all/quantity phải explicit, không suy từ merge-name.
answer.en: Observed-remove/add-wins may preserve a fresh concurrent b2 while removing b1. Resurrection of old b1 after losing tombstones is different. Define removal and quantity semantics explicitly.

question.vi: Một million attempts một SKU thì chỉ thêm shards?
question.en: Do more shards solve a hot SKU with a million attempts?

answer.vi: Không nếu cùng allocation key. Bound admission/queue và authoritative conditional claims. Có thể disjoint escrow budgets để parallelize nhưng cần total conservation và safe transfers; cache/token không thay stock authority.
answer.en: Not when allocation remains one key. Bound admission and authoritative claims. Disjoint escrow budgets can parallelize under conservation and safe transfers; caches/tokens do not replace stock authority.

question.vi: Shuffle 2-of8 có nghĩa chỉ1/28 requests lỗi?
question.en: Does two-of-eight shuffle sharding imply only1/28 failed requests?

answer.vi: Chỉ dưới assumptions phù hợp:2badworkers, uniform subsets và thử cả2distincttargets. Một random attempt vẫn25%fail; sharedrequireddependencyfault làm100%. Overlap combinatorics không tự là availability SLO.
answer.en: Only with two failed workers, uniform subsets and both distinct attempts. One random attempt still fails25percent; shared required failure disables all. Combinatorics alone do not establish an SLO.

question.vi: Authorize/capture dùng cùng orderID làm key mọi nơi?
question.en: Should authorization and capture reuse one order ID everywhere?

answer.vi: Không: scope theo operation/merchant/method và payload; split shipments cần capture IDs riêng cùng aggregate cap. Same-operation retries giữ key; new operations không giả reuse để dedup nhau. Query/reconcile ambiguous outcomes theo provider contract.
answer.en: Scope identities to operations, merchants/methods and payloads. Split shipments need distinct captures plus aggregate limits. Preserve same-operation retries and reconcile uncertainty rather than reuse identities across different operations.

question.vi: Promise trên product page có thể dùng nguyên ở checkout?
question.en: Can a product-page delivery promise be reused unchanged at checkout?

answer.vi: Không tự động. Check validity/cutoff, item/address/service dimensions, current allocation/capacity và accepted quote. Changed date cần policy/consent; multi-package promise khác fastest single item. Cache freshness không là reserved shipping capacity.
answer.en: Revalidate expiry, cutoffs, dimensions and capacity/allocation against the accepted quote. Handle changes explicitly; multiple packages differ from one fastest item. Fresh caches do not reserve shipping capacity.
